title: Wave coarsening drives time crystallization in mechatronic metamaterials
summary: Here we discover a vibrational counterpart-wave coarsening-in active elastic media4-13: vibrations emerge and spontaneously grow in wavelength, period and amplitude, before a globally synchronized state called a time crystal14-17 forms.

title: De novo design of cysteine proteases
summary: Here we describe the de novo design of enzymes that use an activated cysteine nucleophile to hydrolyse the polypeptide backbone in a sequence-dependent manner, with a success rate of 13/69 = 19% and rate enhancements over the background reaction (kcat/kuncat) of up to 3 × 107.

title: Rh3+ stabilized in KRh@MFI catalyses regioselective hydroformylation
summary: This strategy results in a notable enhancement of regioselectivity, with a state-of-the-art reported highest linear to branched aldehydes (l/b) ratio of 817 with 96% undecanal selectivity at 99.8% 1-decene conversion, using NMP as additive.

title: Hidden reaction pathways inform additive engineering for perovskite LEDs
summary: Here we resolve and control the hidden solution-phase chemistry of a ubiquitous additive, 5-aminovaleric acid (5AVA), whose solution-phase reactivity has remained unclear6,9-15.

title: Parity-dependent coupling of molecular spin chains to a superconductor
summary: Here we grow molecular Haldane chains of antiferromagnetically coupled spin-1 triangulene units on a proximitized Au(111)/Nb(110) surface and resolve a parity-dependent coupling of their spin-1/2 edge states to the superconductor by scanning tunnelling spectroscopy.

title: Evaluating space-based methane detection through a one-year blind test
summary: Here we conduct a year-long, single-blind test involving 746 events: 481 methane releases of 9.5-1,183.7 kg h-1 and 265 blank controls.

title: Elp1 is required for myeloid differentiation and brain repopulation
summary: Here we explored whether ex vivo expansion of primary cultured HSPCs (cHSPCs) enables unbiased genetic interrogation of haematopoietic differentiation.

title: Clasping folds enable superior elastic strength of graphene films
summary: Here we report a strategy for preparation of graphene films with a combination of high strength (2.9 GPa), toughness (84.5 MJ m-3) and elastic strain (5%).

title: Jurassic flightless bird reveals early ecological diversity of avialans
summary: Here we report on the discovery of a Late Jurassic avialan, Yuezhuornis yangyuanensis, gen. et sp. nov., from the Zhenghe Fauna of southeastern China9.

title: In vivo engineering of CAR natural killer cells for immunotherapy using ligand-directed lipid nanoparticles
summary: Here we develop NK cell-targeted LNPs (NtLNPs) using engineered biparatopic NK cell ligands to drive receptor-specific uptake and mRNA delivery.

title: Organotypic vascularization improves maturation of human stem cell-derived islets and restores normoglycemia in diabetic mice
summary: Here, we generated vascularized PIOs (VPIOs) by co-culturing PIOs with blood vessel organoids (BVOs), resulting in integrated structures with BVOs-derived capillary networks that penetrate into the islet structures.

title: Modular van der Waals MOSFETs through layer-by-layer chalcogen substitutions
summary: Here, we custom-molded van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures by layer-by-layer vapor-phase chalcogen substitution starting from p-type WSe2 multilayers into which we locally inscribed insulating WOx, n-type WS2, and semimetallic WTe2.

title: Deterministic generation and distribution of genuine multipartite entanglement in macroscopic acoustic resonators
summary: We report the generation and transfer of genuine multimode entanglement across two multimode acoustic resonators.

title: Electrically driven chiral emission from plasmonic tunnel junctions
summary: Our electrically driven approach offers a means for engineering photon spin generation at the nanoscale, highlighting its potential for next-generation optical components in display applications, as well as quantum information processing and photochemistry.

title: Atomic functional site scaffolding in biopolymers with RFdiffusion3
summary: Here, we describe a generative artificial intelligence method for biopolymers, RFdiffusion3 (RFD3), which employs free atom diffusion to satisfy complex sets of atomic constraints more rapidly and accurately than previous methods across several challenges from enzyme design to RNA structure design.

title: Engineering ordered two-dimensional defect phases to strengthen structural alloys
summary: We show that predeformation followed by aging can convert such defects into a designed architecture of ordered defect phases.

title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
summary: We present an experimental study of magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor.

title: Airflows redefine the cost of aerial transport in the wild
summary: Our results revise the classic ranking of locomotion costs, suggesting that flying can be cheaper than swimming though almost as costly as running, depending on interactions between physical environment, morphology, and behavior.

title: Empirical constraints on ice cliff calving
summary: We show that cliff height is highly correlated with mélange thickness, water depth, and crevassing.

title: Dendritic computation for abstract rule-based flexible decision-making
summary: These results indicate that dendritic computation in cortical neurons mediates flexible behavior.

title: Regulation of target gene expression by chromatin-associated protein-coding transcripts in plants
summary: Here, we found that BT2 and GSL8 transcripts modulate target gene transcription independently of their protein products through distinct mechanisms.

title: Structural basis for size-selective perception of chitin in plants
summary: Our findings establish the structural and mechanistic basis of differential chitin perception and receptor complex assembly in chitin-elicited plant immune signaling.

title: A pair of chitosan receptors confer broad-spectrum fungal resistance
summary: These findings uncover a conserved receptor complex for direct chitosan sensing, advancing our understanding of plant-fungus interactions and providing a potential strategy for engineering durable fungal resistance crops.

title: Frequency encoding regulates cell type composition in the small intestine
summary: We uncovered oscillatory expression of the Notch-target protein Hes1 (hairy and enhancer of split 1) that controls cell fate specification in a frequency-dependent manner.

title: Gate-tunable chiral spin mode in WSe 2 /WS 2 moiré superlattices
summary: Here, we report a gate-tunable CSM that occurs between conduction SOC-split minibands in near-0°-twisted WSe2/WS2 bilayers.

title: Ryder: epigenome normalization using a two-tier model and internal reference regions
summary: We present Ryder, a flexible and robust Python package for the normalization of epigenomic signal tracks.

title: Ponatinib–Blinatumomab or Imatinib–Chemotherapy for Adult Ph-Positive ALL
summary: In this phase 3 trial, a frontline chemotherapy-free targeted and immunotherapeutic approach was superior to the use of imatinib and chemotherapy.

title: Phase 2 Trial of Icotrokinra for Patients with Ulcerative Colitis
summary: Among participants with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, a clinical response at week 12 was significantly more common with once-daily oral icotrokinra at each of three tested doses than with placebo.

title: Long-Acting HIV Therapy in African Adults with Adherence Challenges
summary: Among persons with HIV in Africa who have adherence challenges, long-acting cabotegravir plus rilpivirine was noninferior to oral dolutegravir-based therapy for maintaining a viral load of less than 50 copies per milliliter.

title: Nearly half of reef-building corals face elevated relative risk of extinction
summary: Here we reassessed the IUCN Red List status of 892 reef-building coral species, first assessed in 2008 1.

title: Genome-wide CRISPR screen reveals that Wnt signaling regulates lipid accumulation in APOE4 oligodendrocytes
summary: Together, these findings establish a mechanistic framework linking Wnt/GSK3B signaling to APOE4-driven disruptions in oligodendrocyte lipid metabolism and myelination, pointing to GSK3B as a potential therapeutic target for APOE4-associated Alzheimer's disease.

title: Skin fibroblast lineage tracing reveals layer-specific cooperation in wound repair
summary: Here, we employed a dual-recombinase strategy to develop genetic lineage-tracing tools for all five layers of skin fibroblasts: papillary, reticular, hypodermal, panniculus carnosus (PC), and fascia fibroblasts.

title: Multi-omics atlas of chronic exercise
summary: Machine learning identified conserved exercise signatures across mammalian species.

title: Functional diversification of the cephalopod proteome by RNA editing
summary: Here, we integrated proteomics with biochemical and cellular assays to characterize recoding across the Doryteuthis pealeii proteome.

title: An opioid efficacy switch for reversible optical control of analgesia
summary: Here, we develop a reversibly photoswitchable morphinan agonist termed "azo-morphine-3" (AM-3) that interconverts from low to high efficacy in response to light to enable optical control of MOR signaling.

title: Mitochondria-targeted tetraoxanes initiate lipid peroxidation to drive ferroptosis and tumor suppression
summary: Our work provides a protein-targeting-independent metabolic ferroptosis induction strategy for potential cancer therapy.

title: Cellular self-organization orchestrates ferroptosis propagation
summary: We show that cellular self-organization constrains the propagation of ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of oxidative cell death that can otherwise spread as unbounded trigger waves.

title: Comprehensive benchmarking of somatic mutation detection by the SMaHT Network
summary: Our results indicate that bulk, single-cell, and duplex analyses are complementary and that leveraging all three provides comprehensive characterization of mosaicism within tissues.

title: A phenome-wide structural variant map from 467,152 UK Biobank genomes
summary: This study underscores the underestimated role of SVs in human genetics and their potential to advance understanding of human biology and drug discovery.

title: Somatic epimutations cap genetic determinism in the human diploid chromatin epigenome
summary: We present Fiber-seq inferred regulatory elements (FIRE) and show that FIRE provides a more comprehensive and quantitative snapshot of the accessible chromatin landscape across the 6 Gbp diploid human genome, overcoming previously unrecognized biases in existing regulatory element catalogs.

title: A telomere-to-telomere map of somatic mutation burden and functional impact in a cancer
summary: Here, we demonstrate that pairing a near-telomere-to-telomere (near-T2T) diploid assembly of a donor with deep short- and long-read sequencing of their melanoma reveals that 16% of somatic variants localize to sequences absent from GRCh38, with satellite repeats acting as hotspots for UV-associated…

title: Spatiotemporal co-transcriptomics uncovers coordinated rhizobia-legume stress programs supporting nitrogen fixation in Medicago
summary: Here, we applied spatial enhanced resolution omics sequencing (Stereo-seq) to profile Medicago nodules across five developmental stages, generating a co-transcriptomic atlas of nodule development.

title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Non–Insulin-Treated Type 2 Diabetes
summary: Among adults with type 2 diabetes that was not being treated with insulin and was being managed in a primary care setting, the use of CGM led to a greater reduction in the glycated hemoglobin level and to a lower risk of hyperglycemia than routine care.

title: Intermittent or Continuous Renal-Replacement Therapy in Acute Kidney Injury
summary: Among critically ill patients with acute kidney injury who had indications for renal-replacement therapy, intermittent hemodialysis as the initial treatment approach was not shown to be noninferior to continuous renal-replacement therapy with respect to major adverse kidney events by day 90 and was…

title: Catalytic transfer of carbon atoms enables spirofusion of C–C σ-bonds
summary: Here we report a rhodium-catalysed spiro-carbon-atom insertion reaction that converts biphenylene substrates into spirocyclic structures through sequential C-C bond activation.

title: Structural basis of ligand recognition and gating in mosquito IRs
summary: Here, we report cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) structures and functional validation of the IR8a-IR75k complex from the malaria mosquito Anopheles stephensi, a carboxylic acid detector, captured in four states: the ligand-free full-length closed form (apo state), the ligand induced full-length…

title: A pseudoenzyme sensor of trehalose-6-phosphate directly represses the metabolic integrator SnRK1 in plants
summary: These findings resolve a long-standing question in sugar signaling and provide a framework for improving crop carbon-use efficiency.

title: Atomic-scale spin sensing of a 2D d-wave altermagnet via helical tunneling
summary: Here we show that the helical edge modes of the higher-order topological insulator α-Bi4Br4 can serve as a spin-selective scanning tunnelling microscopy probe of the two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic order in the surface layer of KV2Se2O.

title: Selective, Catalytic Oxidation of Polyethylene Surfaces
summary: We demonstrate that the surface ketones can be modified to enhance adhesive strength further and that the augmented surface properties persist for longer than they do after other unselective functionalizations.

title: Rapid CAR-T manufacturing with low-intensity priming enhances CAR-T cell fitness and limits inflammatory programming in a phase 1 study
summary: Here, we developed PrimeCAR, a 2-day manufacturing strategy combining low-intensity anti-CD3 priming with IL-7 and IL-21.

title: Single-cell CRISPR screen maps epigenetic regulators of lineage specification and malignancies in human HSPCs
summary: Here, we developed a massively parallel single-cell CRISPR (scCRISPR) screening platform in primary human hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs), profiling 322 regulators across 172,382 single-perturbed cells.

title: A high-dimensional population code in the bat motor cortex during natural dexterous flight
summary: Here, we performed large-scale wireless recordings from the wing motor cortex of freely flying bats, combined with 3D tracking of wing kinematics.

title: Mechanisms of transcription control by distal enhancers from single-gene nanoscopy
summary: We find that productive interactions are dynamic, occur at a proximity of ≲100 nm, and are coordinated with transcriptional bursts.

title: PTPRS mediates invasion of tetanus neurotoxin into the central nervous system
summary: Thus, PTPRS is the host factor mediating TeNT trafficking into the CNS, revealing a targetable pathway for post-entry intervention and drug delivery into the CNS.

title: Rare k-mers reveal centromere haplogroups underlying human diversity and cancer translocations
summary: Here, we show that rare k-mers in centromeric regions capture lineage-specific variation, defining discrete haplogroups with distinct structural features.

title: Antiviral immunity via telomerase-like reverse transcription in bacteria
summary: Here we identify a new antiviral defense system, DRT10, that associates with a noncoding RNA (ncRNA) to catalyze processive, protein-primed synthesis of tandem-repeat DNA.
